title: has_failures silently swallows dotnet-test failure when trx is empty/missing
details: If dotnet test exits non-zero but the .trx file is absent, empty, or has no UnitTestResult elements, _parse_trx returned empty lists and has_failures returned False, so main() exited 0 — silently swallowing infra/build failures. Fixed: has_failures now also returns True when test_invoked and test_exit_code != 0.
